findings.title: Light opens a traversable route
findings.claim: Within the host pericope, the arriving light and clear Book meet guidance, peaceful ways, emergence from darkness, and straight alignment, so illumination becomes an orienting route that can be traversed.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers نور and كتابٌ مبينٌ meet the independent 5:16 movements يهدي, سبل السلام, يخرج, and صراط مستقيم; the contact changes the gifts from visible information into direction, egress, and ordered travel.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why 5:16's movement from darkness through light to a straight path is already latent in the two gifts arriving here.
findings.containment: The ordinary claim remains that light and a clear Book come from Allah. This is a pericope-bound route effect, not a whole-surah thesis and not a claim that illumination itself supplies obedience.

epistemic.reason: The trusted channel records exact focus and 5:16 source contacts, and the packet supplies matching focus/context root occurrences.

findings.title: Words are restored to working positions
findings.claim: The host pericope lets 5:15's clarification meet the preceding scene of words displaced from their assigned positions and content kept hidden, so disclosure reads as repair of a damaged communicative arrangement.
findings.mechanism: The focus forms تُخْفُونَ and يُبَيِّنُ/مُبِينٌ meet 5:13's يُحَرِّفُونَ ٱلْكَلِمَ عَن مَّوَاضِعِهِ; concealment, displacement, and clarification contact one another and change disclosure into restoration of visibility and use.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive why the messenger's explanation addresses an injured relation between words and their places, while the verse still leaves much material passed over.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains that the messenger explains much of what was hidden from the Book and passes over much. The pericope image does not claim that every word was literally moved or that every concealed matter is exposed.

epistemic.reason: The trusted channel cites exact 5:13 and 5:15 context and focus contacts, with matching supplied branch carriers.

findings.containment: The ordinary claim that a clear Book arrives remains intact. This is an attributed parallel within the declared pericope, not a claim that the focus verse alone narrates the later history or that all readers respond alike.

findings.title: Passing over leaves protected room
findings.claim: The focus's passing over of much material can, in the supplied pericope, carry a secondary process image in which selective non-exposure leaves protected room for correction to grow without coerced total confession.
findings.mechanism: The focus passing-over carrier meets its paired muchness and 5:13's repeated pardon and graceful turning-away; the HFT trace activates growth-when-left as a qualified effect of leaving some material unexposed.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the unexposed remainder as a bounded space in which repair may develop, alongside the ordinary pardon reading.
findings.containment: The immediate syntax still carries pardon or passing over as the primary reading. Growth is an exploratory secondary metaphor, not the translation of يَعْفُوا and not a claim that concealment is always beneficial.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace has exact 5:13 and 5:15 carriers and explicitly marks the growth reading exploratory; the focus branch is qualified and the unresolved contextual branch remains attributed.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Passing over can leave space in which correction is possible.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is unresolved and no independent gloss or facet is asserted.

findings.title: Clarity discriminates and reconnects
findings.claim: The focus clarification can, exploratorily, be heard as separating false adhesions and then reconnecting the record on sound relations, so disclosure includes discrimination as well as explanation.
findings.mechanism: Focus clarity and Book carriers meet 5:14's hostility placed between parties and 5:25's explicit request to separate between sides; the HFT trace makes distinction and reconstruction a contextual effect of clarification.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees that making meaning clear can also sort relations and expose where hostility has occupied the space between people.
findings.containment: The ordinary explanatory force of يُبَيِّنُ and مُبِينٌ remains primary. This exploratory discriminating effect is not authorization for social schism and does not claim that clarity always dissolves every relation.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace supplies exact focus, 5:14, and 5:25 coordinates and explicitly marks the finding exploratory; accepted focus branches and unresolved attributed context branches are kept distinct.

findings.title: The source is met by worship and aid
findings.claim: The added 1:5 prayer gives the focus phrase from Allah a concrete response relation: the named source is the one the speakers worship and from whom they seek aid.
findings.mechanism: The focus Allah occurrence meets the external worship and aid-seeking occurrences; the contact shifts the source phrase from origin alone to origin addressed in worshipful reliance.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the arriving light and Book within a relationship of worship and dependence, rather than as an impersonal delivery from a named source.
findings.containment: The focus still says that the light and Book come from Allah. The external overlay adds the prayer's response posture and does not recast 5:15 as a translation of 1:5.

epistemic.reason: The packet supplies exact focus and lean external root occurrences and an accepted focus branch, but no separate external support or connection trust label.

findings.title: The visible gift is heard as a requested path-marker
findings.claim: The added 1:6-1:7 prayer turns the focus light's route contact into a request and a criterion: the visible gift is heard as a marker for a straight way actively sought and distinguished from angry or lost courses.
findings.mechanism: The focus light carrier meets the external requests for guidance to the straight path and the external contrast between those granted favor, those under anger, and the astray; the contact adds sought direction and discernment to the host pericope's route image.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the focus light not only as an arriving resource but as the visible answer-space for a path that a community asks to be shown and asks to remain on.
findings.containment: The host pericope still supplies the arriving light and clear Book and its own route context. The overlay adds request and path contrast; it does not import an implicit whole-surah reading or claim that every external path word is a gloss of نور.

epistemic.reason: The packet supplies exact focus and external lean root occurrences and an accepted waymark branch, but no separate external connection or trust label.
